issue.title: Add per-tenant rate limit to VOC ingest

blocking_fact: Implementing the rate limit requires editing src/permissions/tenantPolicy.ts (a shared permission gate) and src/voc/ingestPipeline.ts, both consumed across modules — typecheck flags 4 downstream callers of TenantPolicy.resolve.
needed_decision: ARCHITECT must decide whether to widen TenantPolicy.resolve's signature (breaking 4 callers) or add a separate VocRateLimitPolicy alongside it.
